title: 阿斯利康洽购百时美施贵宝？分析师：毫无逻辑
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Big deal in the pharma space AstraZeneca down 7% Bristol Myers up 2.7 after the company is reportedly held early stage talks for a potential merger. That combination would create the world's
segments.zh: 医药领域重磅交易，阿斯利康下跌7%，百时美施贵宝上涨2.7%，此前有报道称双方就潜在合并进行了早期谈判。这一组合将打造全球最大的制药商，年收入约1070亿美元。

segments.en: biggest drug maker with about $107 billion in annual revenue. Let's bring in Bloomberg intelligence senior pharmaceutical analyst Sam Fizzelli for more on this.
segments.zh: 让我们请来彭博智库高级医药分析师Sam Fizzelli，了解更多详情。

segments.en: Sam, what would be the reasoning? What would be the logic behind forming such a behemoth of a drug company? None. Zero. There's really no, I mean every client that I've spoken to is looking at
segments.zh: Sam，这样一家制药巨头背后的逻辑是什么？没有逻辑，零。我接触的每个客户都在质疑，

segments.en: they're saying is either false or there's an element that maybe they have talked to each other about
segments.zh: 他们要么认为报道不实，要么认为双方可能只是就某种业务合并进行过接触，这在医药行业并不罕见。

segments.en: a possible business combination or a part of a business combination that has been known in pharma before where you put your cardiovascular business together, your oncology business together.
segments.zh: 比如将心血管业务或肿瘤业务合并。但说实话，大多数人都在挠头，觉得这毫无意义。

segments.en: But honestly, most people are scratching their heads saying this just doesn't make any sense.
segments.zh: 但说实话，大多数人都在挠头，觉得这毫无意义。

segments.en: AstraZeneca has got very strong double digit growth going forward to 2030. Bristol Myers buy their own admission because of patent tax priorities are not going to have that, are going to have at least
segments.zh: 阿斯利康到2030年有强劲的两位数增长。百时美施贵宝自己承认，由于专利到期，至少会经历一段平稳期，甚至盈利下滑。

segments.en: at best a flat period if not the declining earnings. Why would you want to merge those two elements together? It makes sense from Bristol Myers what sense does it make from AstraZeneca? One of the
segments.zh: 为什么要把这两者合并？对百时美施贵宝有意义，对阿斯利康有什么意义？

segments.en: reasons I've heard for at least considering this plan is that it gives each of the drug makers who are based in different continents more access to the others. Is there anything to that?
segments.zh: 我听到的一个考虑这一计划的原因是，这能让两家位于不同大洲的制药商更好地进入对方市场。这有道理吗？
